text:
toni: FYI PR #4892 (python SDK migration + examples) is failing docs CI. Preview broke with an external link 404 and some lint errors.
ci-bot: docs preview failed for PR #4892 on branch `docs/sdk-python-migration`
- link-check: 1 broken external link (https://old.example.com/sdk-install)
- vale: 2 warnings (Acronym) in `python-sdk.md`
- mdlint: MD041/indentation issue in the installation list

devon: Can you paste the exact link-check output? If it's an external host redirecting, we might swap to the canonical upstream docs or use a note.
toni: Link-check snippet:```
ERROR: https://old.example.com/sdk-install: 404 Not Found
```
rach: Old vendor site removed their install page last month. We should link to our hosted copy under `/reference/legacy-install` or remove the external entirely. Which pages reference this?
nora: Two other docs link to the same URL from `getting-started.md` and `upgrade-notes.md`. We can update references in a follow-up but for this PR let's replace with the internal redirect `/reference/legacy-install` to get the preview green.
toni: Agreed. I'll swap the URL in the examples and add a short parenthetical note: "(legacy install mirrored in our docs)".
ci-bot: Vale details: rule "Acronym" flagged `iam` and `api` in headings — prefer uppercase `IAM` and `API`. File `python-sdk.md` line excerpts:```
## iam permissions
Use the sdk api to create keys.
```
devon: That's noisy but valid. For headings we should use uppercase acronyms (`IAM`, `API`). Small edit.
rach: MD041 is caused by the installation step being indented with 3 spaces in a mixed list, easiest fix is reflow the list so bullets are flush.
toni: I'll make three edits in one commit: 1) swap external URL -> `/reference/legacy-install`, 2) fix headings to `IAM`/`API`, 3) fix list indentation. Want me to also run local lint before pushing?
nora: Yes please run `make docs-lint` and `python tools/check-links.py docs` locally. Saves CI cycles.
toni: Running now locally... `make docs-lint` output shows link-check failing locally too, vale warnings cleared after I updated headings, mdlint fixed after reflow. All good locally. Pushing commit in 10m.
ci-bot: Reminder: release merge window today closes at 09:00 PT for the morning batch. If CI green and you get two approvals we'll slot it.
devon: Happy to review once you push.
rach: I can second-review, aim for quick-approve.
[10 minutes later]
toni: Pushed commit `d4a1f3b` -> branch `docs/sdk-python-migration` with the fixes. PR updated.
ci-bot: CI queued for PR #4892. Running preview...
Status: link-check: OK, vale: OK, md-lint: OK
Preview URL: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-4892
devon: Spot-checking preview now. The mirrored legacy install page renders fine. Example snippets look correct. :thumbsup:
rach: LGTM, approving.
devon: Approved.
release-bot: PR #4892 approved by devon, rach. Added to merge batch for morning 09:00 PT.
ci-bot: Merged at 09:02 PT 1: commit `d4a1f3b` 1: Python SDK migration: external link swapped and heading acronyms fixed.
toni: Thanks folks. I'll open a follow-up to sweep other files that referenced the removed vendor URL so we don't reintroduce this.
nora: Thanks for running the local checks. Small wins for CI quota.
